# Product-Market Fit & Growth Loops Overview

Finding product-market fit (PMF) requires tracking retention metrics rather than vanity metrics.
According to growth experts, if 40% or more of surveyed users report they would be "very disappointed" if your product disappeared tomorrow, you have reached baseline PMF.

## Acquisition & Growth Loops
Growth loops are self-sustaining systems where the output of one user cycle generates input for the next cycle.
The three main types of growth loops are:
1. Viral loops: Users directly invite new users as part of the core product utility.
2. Content/SEO loops: Created content attracts organic search traffic leading to new user signups.
3. Paid loops: Revenue generated from users is reinvested into paid acquisition channels.
